turns.teacher: Good morning children. Today we will do subtraction with bundles and sticks. First sum on the board: fifty two minus twenty seven. Everyone try in your notebook.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Arjoon, you wrote 35. Tell me slowly, how did you get 35? What did you do in the ones and in the tens?
turns.label: ask_to_explain

turns.teacher: Arjun, see, here are 5 bundles of ten and 2 loose sticks. You need 7 sticks but you have only 2. So open one bundle. Now count, how many bundles are left on the table?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Yes, 4 bundles only. So when you borrowed that ten for the ones, what happens to the 5 in the tens place? Is it still 5, or does it become 4?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Very nice Arjun, you crossed out the 5 and wrote 4 above it. That small 4 is what you were forgetting. Now 4 tens minus 2 tens is 2 tens, so the answer is 25.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Sana beta, you were working so quietly. Can you come and show us with the sticks how you did sixty three minus twenty eight?
turns.label: invite_quiet_child
